assumptions.entry_model: Signal-close limit price; 5minute paper timeout; candle backtest fill timing model-limited
assumptions.exits: Frozen structure stop plus native custom ROI2x initial price-risk,8h/4h hold request,2bar cooldown
assumptions.fee_status: conservative research assumption, not verified account tier
assumptions.freeze_rule: No outcome-dependent threshold changes. Software bug fixes logged and rerun all affected outputs.
assumptions.funding: native actual observations required; missing funding blocks complete-economics claim
assumptions.future_reservation: Observations after2026-10-31 not acquired/evaluated in this session; Session3 separately authorized
assumptions.outcome_status_rule: Under30 trades INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE; nonpositive larger samples REJECTED under evaluated assumptions; positive larger samples UNQUALIFIED DEVELOPMENT RESULT
assumptions.regime_labels: Only strategy hourly EMA/ADX filters; no hindsight calendar regimes or optimization
assumptions.sample_identity: All 12 reacquired files byte-identical to Session1: 1201184 bytes
assumptions.universe_selection: BTC, ETH, SOL selected by name as large familiar currently listed contracts before observing results; survivorship/point-in-time eligibility not reconstructed

limitations: No independent holdout, no economic qualification or automatic promotion.
15m limit fills are within-candle simulations; five-minute expiry cannot establish historical queue fills.
Friction stresses deduct additional turnover costs without resimulating fills or drawdown.
Risk controls rely on assumed stop/friction/funding allowances; gaps/outages can exceed them.
UTC realized-loss halt excludes unrealized account losses; full daily-loss ceiling NOT ENFORCED.
Current surviving BTC/ETH/SOL only; correlated days are not independent samples.
